description: Destination public input of a forced transfer: forced_destination_to_field(a) = Poseidon2(FORCED_DEST, address_to_field(a)). Like address_to_field it is not implemented in Noir: the clawback circuit receives it as an opaque public input, so the derivation exists only in the contract (storage.rs::forced_destination_to_field) and in each auditor client that builds the proof. The vectors use the two addresses of address_to_field.json. They were produced by the contract implementation and pin it against regressions; an independent client implementation should reproduce them before it is relied on.
